headline: Barcelona's Deco says Liverpool hold a buy option on Ronald Araujo after season-long loan
facts: Araujo, 27, joined Liverpool on loan from Barcelona in the summer and has two goals in 15 appearances.
ESPN reports the permanent option at 55 million euros; Goal.com reports it as 47 million pounds. It is an option, not an obligation.
Araujo would also need to agree new personal terms, and Deco hinted the timing and final fee could be negotiated.
background: Araujo is a Uruguayan centre-back and former Barcelona captain who left the Catalan club on loan in August 2026.

headline: Napoli want 7 million euros for Kevin De Bruyne after PSV's 2 million opener
facts: PSV reportedly opened with a 2 million euro January bid, which Napoli rejected; Gazzetta dello Sport says Napoli want about 7 million euros.
At that price Napoli would recover roughly 10 million euros overall because remaining wages and bonuses would also be cleared.
De Bruyne's contract has under a year left plus a 12-month option that Napoli are widely expected not to use; coach Allegri reportedly opposes a mid-season sale.
background: De Bruyne, 35, is the Belgian playmaker who spent a decade at Manchester City before moving to Napoli.

headline: Van Dijk and Liverpool split on length of new contract as Milan circle
facts: Van Dijk wants a two-year extension; Liverpool are reportedly offering one year, with a further year as an option, at considerably lower pay.
His current deal runs to 30 June 2027 and his wage is reported at about 21 million pounds gross a year.
AC Milan reportedly rate him a top target and would make a formal offer if talks fail (Sportitalia report).
background: Van Dijk joined Liverpool from Southampton in January 2018 and has won the Premier League twice and the Champions League once there.
footage_terms: Virgil van Dijk Liverpool best defending

headline: Real Madrid reportedly agree Brahim Diaz extension to 2031 with a billion-euro clause
facts: El Chiringuito reports Madrid agreed to extend Diaz until 2031, with a release clause of about one billion euros.
He has played only 149 La Liga minutes this season.
Besiktas reportedly hosted his father in Istanbul for three days and are considering a January approach.
background: Diaz joined Real Madrid from Manchester City in 2019 and later spent time on loan at AC Milan.

headline: Milan eye McTominay as he asks Napoli for 7 million euros a year
facts: McTominay's Napoli contract runs to June 2028 and renewal talks are on hold; he reportedly wants 7 million euros a season, which Napoli see as excessive.
Milan's new Adidas deal from 2028-29 is reported at about 500 million euros over 10 seasons, around 50 million a season plus result clauses.
McTominay is an Adidas ambassador, which could help a Milan move; Real Madrid and Manchester United are also reported to be monitoring.
background: McTominay is a Scottish midfielder who came through Manchester United's academy before joining Napoli.

headline: Six clubs chase Feyenoord winger Anis Hadj Moussa as price passes 35 million pounds
facts: Feyenoord reportedly rejected initial enquiries around the 35 million pound mark.
Newcastle may have missed a chance at about 33 million pounds in the summer; they signed Bazoumana Toure from Hoffenheim for 43 million pounds instead.
The 24-year-old Algerian has 8 goals in his first 15 games this season.
background: Hadj Moussa is an Algerian international right winger who scored 14 goals and made 7 assists for Feyenoord last season.

headline: Monza ask 35 million euros for Gustavo Varela, bought for 2.5 million euros months ago
facts: Monza paid Benfica 2.5 million euros for the Portuguese forward a few months ago and now want a guaranteed 35 million.
Benfica have a match right and 20 percent of the profit on a future sale.
Juventus, Napoli and Tottenham are all reported as interested; Napoli have a strong relationship with his agency.
background: Varela is a Portuguese forward born in 2005 with nine league goals this season and a Portugal call-up.

headline: Leipzig owe Brighton 25 million euros for Brajan Gruda as Bayern watch
facts: Leipzig must pay 25 million euros to make the deal permanent once he plays three Bundesliga games, possibly by mid-January.
Leipzig paid a 1 million euro loan fee in early February 2026.
Leipzig would reportedly only sell next summer for around 100 million euros; the permanent deal would run to 2031 and he has no release clause.
background: Gruda is a German winger who can play on either wing or as a number ten and is on loan at Leipzig from Brighton.

headline: Guardiola's agent denies official Saudi national team offer
facts: Agent Josep Maria Orobitg told Al-Maidan that Guardiola has not received an official offer from the Saudi federation.
Only indirect contact through intermediaries has happened; reports said Saudi Arabia approached him to succeed Giorgos Donis.
Guardiola is not considering offers for now and will review them before next season, including from Saudi Pro League clubs.
background: Guardiola managed Manchester City from 2016 to 2026, winning four straight league titles from 2021 to 2024 and the 2023 Champions League.

headline: Barcelona walk away from Manchester United teenager JJ Gabriel over a roughly 10 million euro package
facts: Journalist Sique Rodriguez valued the whole operation at close to 10 million euros, including salary, family payments and intermediary fees.
United would receive only about 350,000 euros in training compensation.
Real Madrid are reportedly close to finalising the move and United are checking whether outside parties approached the 16-year-old while he was registered with them.
background: Gabriel is a 16-year-old United forward who asked to leave in September and confirmed his departure on 17 November.

headline: Valencia reportedly ask about Ter Stegen as Barcelona still pay 90 percent of his Ajax wages
facts: Barcelona reportedly pay 90 percent of his wages while he is on loan at Ajax; his Barcelona deal runs to 2028.
Valencia's sporting director Braulio Vazquez has reportedly asked about his availability; Valencia would likely need to cover far more wages than Ajax do.
Pitchwise Holdings bought a 42 percent stake from Peter Lim's Meriton Holdings, still awaiting approval.
background: Ter Stegen, 34, is the German goalkeeper who is first choice at Ajax but not in Hansi Flick's long-term plans at Barcelona.

headline: Atletico reportedly demand about 500 million euros for Julian Alvarez as Arsenal meet his camp
facts: Atletico reportedly want about 500 million euros to let Alvarez go.
Barcelona were his preferred destination but president Enrique Cerezo refused to strengthen a direct rival.
Arsenal representatives reportedly met him and his agents in Madrid and could bid in January with a higher salary.
background: Alvarez is an Argentine forward who left Manchester City for Atletico Madrid in 2025.

headline: Barcelona reportedly told Lisandro Martinez's agent they do not want him on a free
facts: His United contract ends in summer 2027, so he could leave on a free.
Deco reportedly told agent Pedro Bravo that Barcelona do not like him and he does not fit their needs.
Interest from Barcelona is described as fading though not fully ruled out.
background: Martinez is an Argentina international defender who joined United from Ajax in 2022.

headline: Real Madrid expected to use 80 million euro option on Nico Paz
facts: ESPN says Madrid are expected to trigger an 80 million euro release clause, with a deadline reportedly next summer; Goal.com describes it as a buy-back option of the same size.
Paz joined Como for 6 million euros in 2024; a restructured deal last summer raised the price.
Chelsea, Manchester United and Arsenal are also reported to be monitoring him (Goal).
background: Paz is a 22-year-old Argentine midfielder who left Real Madrid for Como in 2024.

headline: Kovacic's Manchester City deal runs out and Atletico wait
facts: City must sell him in January or lose him for free at the end of the season.
He has played 8 games and 373 minutes this season, with one goal and one assist.
Atletico reportedly rate him highly (Marca); market value is estimated around 10 million euros.
background: Kovacic is a 32-year-old Croatian midfielder at City.

headline: Arsenal revive interest in Nico Williams, whose clause is 100 million euros
facts: His 2025 contract extension includes a 100 million euro exit clause.
He is reportedly open to a move.
Arsenal are also considering Endrick, Antonio Nusa, Kevin Schade and Alex Baena.
background: Williams is a Spain winger who came through the Athletic Club system.

headline: Juventus CEO says settlement agreement limits spending ahead of January
facts: Carnevali said the settlement agreement is one of the main difficulties and he promises nothing special for January.
Juventus want cost-effective signings and could sell surplus wide attackers to fund priority targets.
Priority targets are a striker and a left-back; Yildiz, Locatelli and Thuram have had serious injuries.
background: Carnevali is Juventus CEO; the club has Luciano Spalletti as head coach.

headline: Juventus confirm youngster Augusto Owusu extension to 2031
facts: The midfielder, born in 2005, signed until 30 June 2031.
He made his first-team debut on 17 September 2026 in the Europa League against NEC.
He has 59 appearances for Juventus Next Gen.
background: Owusu came through the Juventus academy, went out on loan in 2022-23, then played for the Primavera and Next Gen teams.

headline: Bruno Fernandes: United offer extension to 2029 while Milan and Galatasaray eye a free
facts: ESPN's roundup says United offered an extension to 2029 but no agreement exists.
He is reportedly wanted by Milan and Galatasaray as a free agent in July and turned down Al Hilal last June.
A separate ESPN piece says United can trigger a one-year extension to 2028, so the terms are reported inconsistently.
background: Fernandes, 32, is the United captain who joined from Sporting in 2020.

headline: Real Madrid's Tchouameni signs new contract until 2032
facts: ESPN lists the new deal as a done deal, running to 2032.
The roundup gives no wage or clause details.
background: Tchouameni is a French midfielder who joined Real Madrid from Monaco in 2022.

headline: Pochettino's United squad audit lists fees and wages, including Rashford at 325,000 pounds a week
facts: ESPN lists Rashford's wages at 325,000 pounds a week, the club's highest, and says he had failed loan moves in the last two summers.

Reported fees include Sesko 85 million euros from Leipzig, Cunha 62.5 million pounds from Wolves, Baleba 65 million pounds from Brighton, Ugarte 50 million euros from PSG and De Ligt 45 million euros from Bayern.
The audit recommends keeping Sesko and Cunha and moving on Rashford and De Ligt.
background: Pochettino is United's new head coach, hired after Michael Carrick was sacked; Rashford came through United's academy.

headline: Pochettino's US contract extension had a release clause that cleared the way to United
facts: His August extension with the US team included a release clause and his representatives told United about it.
He is on a two-year deal at United according to the article; no compensation figure is given.
United sacked Carrick about 15 games into his permanent job; Pochettino's first game is at Liverpool on Sunday.
background: Pochettino was in charge of the US team until the World Cup round-of-16 loss to Belgium in early July 2026.

headline: Messi tops MLS pay at 28.33 million dollars, ahead of Lewandowski and Griezmann
facts: Messi's guaranteed pay is 28.33 million dollars, up from 20.45 million a year earlier.
Lewandowski earns 19.51 million, Griezmann 13.94 million, Son 11.25 million and Embolo 10.81 million.
Inter Miami's payroll of 59.37 million dollars is a record and more than double that of 25 of the other 29 teams.
background: Messi joined Inter Miami in 2023 after leaving Paris Saint-Germain.

headline: Bournemouth reportedly want 100 million pounds each for Kroupi and Alex Scott
facts: The Sun reports Bournemouth want 100 million pounds for Kroupi, 20; Arsenal, Barcelona and PSG are keen.
Daily Star says they also want 100 million for Scott, 23, who has turned down several contract extensions.
Liverpool, Arsenal and Chelsea are linked with Scott.
background: Bournemouth are a Premier League club now fielding two young players reportedly valued at nine figures.

headline: Barcelona and Real Madrid chase Brighton's Luka Vuskovic, 46 million pounds in the summer
facts: The 19-year-old centre-back's Brighton contract runs to June 2031.
ESPN says Brighton signed him from Tottenham for 46 million pounds this summer.
Brighton are expected to listen to offers at the end of the season for a substantial fee.
background: Vuskovic is a young Croatian centre-back described in the press as the new Rodri.

headline: Besiktas reportedly explore January loan for United's Matthijs de Ligt
facts: TEAMtalk reports Besiktas are exploring a January move; United would want an obligation to buy in any loan.
Fulham's Calvin Bassey is linked as a possible replacement.
ESPN's audit says United paid 45 million euros for him.
background: De Ligt, 27, joined United from Bayern Munich.
footage_terms: Matthijs de Ligt Manchester United highlights

headline: Vinicius Junior's summer saga: Madrid's club-record 125 million euro signing Diomande now competes with him
facts: Diomande was signed for a club-record 125 million euros and competes with Vinicius for the left wing.
Vinicius was heavily linked with a summer move to Arsenal and has said the offers and contract talks distracted him.
He has one league goal for Madrid this season but five for Brazil in November friendlies, including a hat trick against Singapore.
background: Vinicius is Real Madrid's Brazilian winger; the club coach this season is Jose Mourinho per ESPN.
footage_terms: Vinicius Junior Brazil hat trick Singapore

headline: Barcelona's Alejandro Balde: wanted by United and Liverpool, 40 million euros mentioned, Deco says no sale
facts: ESPN reports a possible exit at around 40 million euros with Barcelona preferring a permanent sale to a loan; Juventus are keen on a loan.
Deco says Barcelona are not looking to sell unless the player asks to leave.
All five of Balde's appearances this season were as a substitute; Goal says he has 173 appearances since 2021.
background: Balde is a left-back and Barcelona academy graduate.

headline: Manchester United weigh a 40 million euro bid for Marseille's Hojbjerg
facts: ESPN's roundup says United could offer 40 million euros for the 31-year-old midfielder.
Juventus are also interested, and the United move may depend on whether Weston McKennie goes the other way.
Barcelona are also reported to be revisiting Alejandro Balde as a United target.
background: Hojbjerg, 31, is a Danish midfielder now at Marseille.
